topic: mTOR pathway: master regulator of cell growth and aging
caption: Did you know your cells have a 'master regulator' of growth and aging? 🌟 The mTOR pathway is like a cellular 'thermostat' that controls how your cells grow, divide, and age. 🔬 By understanding how mTOR works, you can unlock the secrets to healthy aging and even potentially prevent diseases like cancer and Alzheimer's. 💡 Save this so you don't lose it.
